claim: Cheap L2 auto-router chooses solo vs team vs explore without an extra LLM, copying Grok Build's explore=readonly-codebase vs parent-implementation split. Session must actually dispatch builtin explore, not only keyword-match.

clocks.route_decision: ModeRouter.route() only. Cheap L2, no extra LLM.
clocks.first_progress: Session.prompt → first ProgressUpdate/AgentEvent. This is the 1s/3s harness gate (stub/appserver stub).

clocks.product_ttft: provider first useful chunk with thinking ON. Historical latency-ttft.json 4–12s. Cannot meet 1s while thinking is required; see auto-route-cache-hit.json.

simple_ttft_s.definition: Harness first-progress UPPER bound for greeting / single-file bugfix. Stub may be faster than 0.5s; that is not a fail. Lower 0.5s is the product-latency band, not a must-be-slower gate.

complex_ttft_s.definition: Harness first-progress UPPER bound for explore dispatch or team Coordinator setup. Stub may be faster than 2.8s.

gates.cache_definition: R7 warm-turn Primary prefix/identity cache 97% with thinking ON. Tool schema order stays sorted; task stays in prefix when subagents are on so opt-in does not rotate tools_digest mid-session. Cold-start aggregate (cache-hit-rate.json 91.22%) is not this gate.
